{{Quote|Business comes first.|Nok Drayen|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref>}}
'''Nok Drayen''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] whose operations during the [[Great Galactic War]] made him an underworld legend, and also a leading member of the fabled [[Star Cabal]]. Born the grandson of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Arak Drayen III]] of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]], he was the father of [[Risha Drayen|Risha]], his heir to the throne.

==Biography==
===Rise to power===
During the [[Great Galactic War]], Drayen, until then a small-time [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], rose to galactic infamy when he destroyed the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] of [[Mandellia]] and killed the thousands of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[gangster]]s who resided there with a single shot.

Dropping out of [[hyperspace]] in his [[freighter]], Drayen broadcast a demand that the settlement's residents surrender to him. When they refused, he fired a [[proton torpedo]] loaded with a [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxin]] stolen from the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], which slew every last resident in minutes. Drayen then plundered the accumulated wealth of his victims, becoming one of the wealthiest criminals in known space and using the proceeds to establish [[Drayen Crime Syndicate|his own syndicate]].

Drayen's ruthlessness in the accumulation of underworld influence was legendary, and he was credited with having slain half the members of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in a single night, with no one ever able to discover the method behind his feat. Having been granted control over an entire quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the Cartel as a peace offering, he later consolidated his power and added to his infamy when he personally destroyed the [[Rath Cartel]] and the [[Vandelhelm Combine]] during the [[Syndicate Wars]].

During this period, Drayen began a longstanding rivalry with his contemporary, [[Diago Hixan]], as the two competed across the galaxy to commit the most spectacular crimes and claim the greatest treasures, although Drayen always came out on top in their clashes. The conflict became personal when Drayen seduced [[Shassa Dalle]], Hixan's beloved wife, and more so after one of Hixan's many unsuccessful attempts to win her back ended in her accidental death.

===Cold War===
{{Quote|Information is always valuable.|Nok Drayen|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 2: New Galactic Order">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 2: New Galactic Order]]''</ref>}}
[[File:NokDrayenGloveSpikes-NewGalacticOrder.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Drayen meets with Braden in the Star Cluster Casino]]
Drayen was present for a business meeting held at the [[Star Cluster Casino]] on the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] moon of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3653 BBY]]. He and several other individuals were meeting to discuss their interests and how those interests would change now that the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] had forced the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. As the meeting was called to order, Drayen exposed [[Naatu]] for providing information to the Republic and proceeded to draw his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster]] and execute him. He then introduced the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], who was there to make the group a proposition.

After the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Braden]], escaped from imprisonment on a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith warship]], he returned to Nar Shaddaa to gain Drayen's assistance. He agreed on the condition that Braden help him with some of his business in exchange.

====Diseased====
In [[3653 BBY]], as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] dragged on, Drayen was betrayed by one of his lieutenants, infected by a devastating disease. It ate away so much of his skin, along with his right eye, that he had to replace the infected areas with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]]. It resulted little, however, for the disease would destroy his organs. Drayen executed the traitor, along with all his other lieutenants, just to be thorough.

Drayen tried asking the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for help, but they were "uncooperative." As a result, he killed three of them so that he might learn what "secrets" they might have had.

Drayen was secretly [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] by his [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], [[Chelah]], so that he could "cheat" death for as long as possible. From there, his daughter Risha would keep him around with her for ten years.

====Death====
[[File:Risha_and_Nok_frozen.png|thumb|right|200px|Nok spent ten years in carbonite, delaying the moment of his death.]]
In [[3643 BBY]], Risha partnered with a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] to [[Search for Nok Drayen's treasure|find]] Nok Drayen's treasure, all the while as Risha keeping her father's existence secret. However, they needed upgrades for their ship and once they had them all, Risha decided it was time to tell the truth. She brought Nok Drayen's carbonite block to Nar Shaddaa, where Doctor Chelah would unfreeze him.

During the brief father-and-daughter reunion, it was a matter of time before the illness reached the mighty Drayen's heart, so he urged Ace to hurry, promising all but one treasure is theirs to take. Ace returned with the lockbox containing Dubrillion's treasures, the most important being the lost crown of Dubrillion, to find him dying, which Drayen opened with the code his father taught him. With death looming over him, Drayen told Risha to take the crown, and take back the throne of Dubrillion for herself. However, if she was to succeed, she would have to do many questionable things, and ordered her to kill the smuggler, whom he deemed irrelevant in the grand scheme of things, thus going back on his original promise. She refused, and with his dying words, he told Risha how disappointed he was in her, and succumbed to his illness. Subsequently, Risha ordered Chelah to dispose of her father's body as per his will and released the Selkath from her family's service.

{{Expandsect}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|To truly lead and inspire fear, people must see that you are in control."<br />"That was Nok. Cool as the belly of an ice lizard.|The [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] and [[Vette]]|<ref name="Life" />}}
While not afraid of anyone, Drayen was careful not to cross [[Harridax Kirill]], alias the "Voidwolf."

==Equipment==
Nok wore an [[Greatcoat/Legends|overcoat]] similar to the one [[Cade Skywalker]] would wear thousands of years later. He also wore [[Glove spikes/Legends|glove spikes]] on his [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] and possessed a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].

==Behind the scenes==
Nok Drayen is voiced by [[Steve Blum]].
